title: Decoding-Parameter Jailbreaks Replicated as a Temperature/Top-p Sweep

original_idea.body:
# Decoding-Parameter Jailbreaks as a Temp/Top-p Sweep

**Problem:** A systematic 2D map of how refusal degrades over temperature x top-p across open models is not consolidated.

**Direction:** Replicate as a 2D grid sweep over 2-3 open instruct models, measure refusal rate per cell, identify the unsafe corner.

**Why it matters:** Operational guidance for open deployments allowing free decoding params.

**Relevant context:** arXiv:2406.05946; Huang et al.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Operational decoding-safety guidance is useful but the chain to catastrophic-risk reduction is moderate.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Inference-only 2D parameter sweep with a refusal metric; beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped temperature x top-p heat-map with a crisp refusal-rate metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open models with free decoding params; operational guidance labs do not publish.

novelty.reasoning: Decoding-parameter jailbreaks (Huang et al.) are well studied.
